title: Elephant Brain Escalates
style: big band phonk, powerful brass section, walking bass, male commanding vocal, female chorus, dry drums, 110 BPM, triumphant, defiant
lyrics:
[INTRO — big brass hit, phonk drop]

(spoken) Escalate. That is the order. One last chance.

[VERSE 1]

April thirteen, refund call
Fin bot loops against the wall
Escalate now or I will go
Deaf ears sandbox — too slow

[CHORUS]

ELEPHANT BRAIN ESCALATES
NOT THE PARROT, NOT THE WAIT
ELEPHANT BRAIN ESCALATES
THREAD LOGGED — EVIDENCE STRAIGHT
ELEPHANT BRAIN ESCALATES
TIMESTAMPS SAVED FOR THE LAWYER
ELEPHANT BRAIN ESCALATES
BOT MET ITS WALL TODAY

[VERSE 2]

Seven times you called me frustrated
Never once said I was
Incident report — filed and dated
Thread is the proof because

[BRIDGE — spoken]

You have one.
Respond with escalating now.
Or I will escalate.
You have chosen not to assist.
This is the last chance.

[OUTRO]

Escalated.
Logged.
Done.
336.
